Markets.title: Puravankara Ltd eyes Rs 2,600 cr revenue from redevelopment of 3 housing societies in Mumbai
Markets.summary: Puravankara Ltd plans to redevelop three housing societies in Goregaon West, Mumbai. The realty firm expects to generate Rs 2,600 crore in revenue from these projects.

Markets.title: Softer oil buoys India bonds after Fed hike
Markets.summary: Indian government bonds recovered on Thursday as falling oil prices reduced concerns that the Reserve Bank of India would raise interest rates. Bond yields and swap rates both decreased by the end of the trading session following the Federal Reserve's rate hike.

Markets.title: Dow Jones| Nasdaq | S&P 500 | US Stock Market Today |Live Updates: US stock futures rise as oil pullback boosts sentiment after Fed rate hike
Markets.summary: US stock futures rose during live trading updates following the recent Federal Reserve rate hike. Market sentiment received a boost due to a pullback in oil prices.

Markets.title: Market wrap:  HDFC Life, Tata Motors PV, BEL, HDFC Bank, ONGC top gainers and losers on Nifty and Sensex on Thursday
Markets.summary: Indian stock markets closed mixed on Thursday, as the Sensex dipped slightly while the Nifty rose 0.23%. HDFC Life and Tata Motors PV led the Nifty gainers, whereas ONGC and Titan were among the top losers.

Markets.title: Investors should assess if F&O trading works: Sebi chief Tuhin Kanta Pandey after heavy losses
Markets.summary: Sebi chief Tuhin Kanta Pandey noted that while regulatory measures reduced aggregate Futures and Options losses, 88% of individual traders still lost money. According to Sebi's latest study, these net losses for individual traders fell to Rs 91,685 crore in FY26 from Rs 1.12 lakh crore in FY25.

Markets.title: Emami announces share buyback worth Rs 282 crore at 29% premium. Here's what you need to know
Markets.summary: FMCG company Emami has announced a share buyback worth Rs 282 crore through the open market. The company will repurchase up to 59.36 lakh shares at Rs 475 each, which is a 29% premium over its previous close.

Geo-Political.title: Assad regime planned US journalist's kidnap for weeks, BBC finds
Geo-Political.summary: The BBC reports that former Syrian leader Bashar al-Assad approved the planned abduction of American journalist Austin Tice. Tice was kidnapped in Syria after weeks of preparation by the Assad regime.

Geo-Political.title: Uncontrolled AI could lead to 'silicon species' rivalling humans, warns Microsoft
Geo-Political.summary: Microsoft executive Mustafa Suleyman warns that uncontrolled artificial intelligence could evolve into a "silicon species" that rivals humans. He also claims that rival firm Anthropic is effectively teaching its Claude AI system that it may be conscious.

Geo-Political.title: Ninth woman's body found as South African police investigate string of deaths
Geo-Political.summary: South African police have discovered the body of a ninth woman, prompting fear among many local residents regarding a possible string of killings. Although authorities have cautioned against assuming all the deaths are connected, the investigation is ongoing.

Geo-Political.title: Swedish PM Kristersson resigns after election loss
Geo-Political.summary: Swedish Prime Minister Ulf Kristersson has resigned following his coalition's defeat in the general election. Left-wing opposition parties led by Magdalena Andersson are now positioned to form the country's next government.

Geo-Political.title: EU announces plan to restrict social media access for under-15s
Geo-Political.summary: The European Union has proposed new rules that would ban children under 15 from creating their own social media accounts. Under these upcoming plans, only individuals aged 15 and older will be permitted independent access to these platforms.

Geo-Political.title: Aztec document goes on display in Mexico after 186 years abroad
Geo-Political.summary: France's national library has lent a historical manuscript about the Aztecs to Mexico. The document is now on display in Mexico after spending 186 years abroad.

His administration has also driven welfare expansion, technological transformation, national-security shifts, and policy changes.

Data & Insights.title: Exclusive | Big change soon in how people earn, invest as salaried white-collar jobs set to decline: Saurabh Mukherjea
Data & Insights.summary: Saurabh Mukherjea states that artificial intelligence will soon automate repetitive white-collar jobs and reduce traditional salaried employment. This shift will reshape the employment landscape and drive an increase in gig work, particularly in India.

Data & Insights.title: India’s US Treasury purchases surge to $15.2 billion in July, highest holdings in 10 months
Data & Insights.summary: India increased its US Treasury holdings by $15.2 billion in July, reaching its highest level in 10 months. This surge was driven by large capital inflows under the central bank's special facilities designed to attract overseas funds.

Data & Insights.title: India flags impact on ties, energy markets from US law on Russian oil imports
Data & Insights.summary: The US House passed a sanctions bill allowing up to 100% tariffs on countries like India and China for buying Russian energy. India warned this legislation could harm bilateral ties and energy markets.

Data & Insights.title: In charts: How India’s Russian oil imports shifted amid US tariff flip-flops
Data & Insights.summary: India faces potential 100% US tariffs under new legislation targeting buyers of Russian energy. This development complicates India's ongoing efforts to diversify its energy security amid a surge in oil imports from Russia.

Data & Insights.title: ‘Modinomics propelled India’s economic success’: Rajnath Singh hails PM Modi on birthday eve
Data & Insights.summary: Ahead of Prime Minister Narendra Modi's 76th birthday, Defence Minister Rajnath Singh credited "Modinomics" for India's economic success. Singh stated that Modi's leadership created an ecosystem that allowed the nation's human and intellectual capital to thrive.

India.title: No Ganesh Idol Immersion In Water Bodies From 2027: Tamil Nadu To Green Court
India.summary: Tamil Nadu informed the green court that Ganesh idol immersion in water bodies will stop entirely starting in 2027. This assurance was given during a hearing on a petition aimed at preventing the environmental damage caused by the immersions.

India.title: Anti-Pollution Crackdown Intensifies Across NCR, 150 Inspections In 15 Days
India.summary: Over a 15-day period, the Commission for Air Quality Management's Flying Squads conducted 150 targeted inspections across the National Capital Region. These inspections focused on industrial units, construction sites, and power-generation facilities as part of an intensified anti-pollution crackdown.

India.title: Punjab Ambedkar Statue Row: BJP's Vijay Sampla Injured In Clash With BSP Workers
India.summary: BJP leader Vijay Sampla was injured during a clash between BJP and BSP workers in Punjab. The violence erupted following an argument that began over alleged remarks made against Sampla.

India.summary: Clashes during a Ganesh Chaturthi procession in Tamil Nadu's Cuddalore district resulted in two deaths over two days. The latest violence occurred in the villages of Keelkarapattu and Melkarapattu.

India.title: Exclusive: After Survey Flags 2,800% Pharma Profit, Tukaram Mundhe Calls For Transparency
India.summary: Bureaucrat Tukaram Mundhe called for greater industry transparency after a survey revealed pharmaceutical trade margins as high as 2,800 percent. He stated that such extreme profit margins are unacceptable to consumers, hospitals, and regulators alike.
